# Additional reference controls

This supplemental comparison was specified while the original development grid was training. It uses the ensemble sealed by the original protocol and evaluates the same held-out learners once. The ten original contrasts retain their original decision. Report a separate family with all sixteen controls using one-sided Holm-adjusted paired learner t tests against the same 0.005 nat margin, simultaneous two-sided Bonferroni intervals, and identical learner weights. The decision requires all sixteen margin tests to pass. Keep all six additional losses to allow recalculation. No revision to the ensemble, its grids, or its features is part of this comparison.

The original ACL evaluation's Table 2 also includes the authors' Leitner and Pimsleur models, HLR without lexemes with and without the auxiliary half-life loss, and logistic regression without lexemes. Use the released implementation. For each of the latter three models, use the same four learning rates, seed, training order, number of passes and raw-versus-sigmoid choice as its original competitor. For the two parameter-free models, use the training-history count feature defined by the authors and allow the same sigmoid recalibration. Include the additional simple predictor (prior correct + 2)/(prior seen + 4), a field computed by the reference loader. That quantity is an extra control here. It has no entry in the authors' Table 2. Use the same calibration and selection learners for all six controls. Save the settings, development results and script digest before reading held-out outcomes. Attribute the calculations to Settles and Meeder and keep the fitted objects and the raw release local.

[Original Table 2 and feature definitions](https://aclanthology.org/P16-1174/) · [Upstream software](https://github.com/duolingo/halflife-regression/tree/0041df0dcd436bf1b4aa7a17a020d9c670db70d8)
